title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.

We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.

This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.

The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).

Our Values

We're proud to share the values we live by. They're not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.

#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don't leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India's most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world's fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we've grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK's Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer's digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers' attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK's Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be at the forefront of CloudSEK's growth. You'll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia's leading cybersecurity company.

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification: Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..Etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.

title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description:
Company Description

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database.

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment, working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems
  • Support and troubleshoot time-series databases
  • Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data)
  • Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools
  • Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang
  • Collaborate with vendors (e.G. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues
  • Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution
  • Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support
  • Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA)
  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments
  • Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Experience with Refinitiv SLang
  • Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools
  • Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms

What We're Looking For

  • Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues
  • Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders
  • Structured and analytical thinking
  • Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues

What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager

Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C (exclusive membership services), B2B (corporate travel management), and B2B2C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool.

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.

CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

We are looking for a CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.

Main Responsibilities

- Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

- Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

- Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

- Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.

Requirements

- Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

- Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

- Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

- Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

- Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a "learning by doing" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

- Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus

Why Join Us

- Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

- Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

- Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

- Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements

bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company's evolution and stakes.

Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws).
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.

Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.

Important Note Before Applying:

Let's keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume. We're not looking for someone who just "gets it" — we need a self-starter ready to deliver results from day one.

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms;
we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we're excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let's keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Full Stack Sênior – Ia/Llm
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para atuar na construção de aplicações com IA/LLMs em produção, com foco em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e integrações com serviços de inferência (model serving).

A pessoa irá desenvolver soluções ponta a ponta utilizando .NET (C#) no backend, Angular no frontend, Python para rotinas de IA e pipelines, além de SQL Server e bases vetoriais para persistência e busca semântica. O objetivo é entregar produtos robustos, com qualidade, segurança e boa experiência para o usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades full stack com IA: chat corporativo, busca semântica, assistentes e copilotos;
  • Implementar e evoluir pipelines de RAG: ingestão, chunking, embeddings, indexação e retrieval
  • Integrar aplicações com LLMs via API/endpoint e/ou servidores/plataformas de inferência;
  • Construir APIs e serviços em .NET (C#) para integração com LLMs, RAG e sistemas internos
  • Implementar UI em Angular (streaming de resposta, histórico, feedback do usuário, filtros e controles)
  • Desenvolver rotinas/serviços em Python para ingestão, geração de embeddings e automações
  • Trabalhar com SQL Server e bases vetoriais (indexação e busca por similaridade com metadados)
  • Implementar tratamento de erros, resiliência (timeouts/retry) e controles operacionais
  • Atuar com segurança e governança (autenticação, autorização, trilhas e privacidade/LGPD)
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de engenharia (testes, code review, versionamento e CI/CD)

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack em produção
  • .NET (C#) para APIs/serviços (REST, autenticação/autorização, integrações)
  • Angular (componentização, consumo de APIs, estado e performance)
  • Python para rotinas de IA/integração (scripts, serviços leves, consumo de APIs)
  • SQL Server (modelagem, queries e performance básica)

Experiência prática com LLMs em produção:

  • Consumo via API/endpoint, streaming, controle de contexto e custos
  • Noções de validação/guardrails (entrada/saída, políticas e limites)

Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) em projeto real:

  • Ingestão, embeddings, indexação e retrieval (com filtros por metadados quando necessário)

Experiência com base vetorial / busca semântica:

  • pgvector, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate ou Qdrant (ou equivalente)

Experiência com inferência/model serving:

  • Integração/uso de pelo menos um: vLLM, TGI, Ollama, llama.Cpp, Triton ou endpoint gerenciado
  • Noções de latência, concorrência e timeouts

Memória de longo prazo em aplicações com LLMs (nível sênior):

Working at Bettr means being part of the Ant International ecosystem. You'll have the resources of a global fintech giant with the agility of a high-growth startup. We value innovation, data-backed decisions, and, above all, the drive to build something meaningful.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O projeto envolve sustentação e evolução de soluções SAP voltadas à gestão e arquivamento de dados, com alta exigência em performance, disponibilidade e governança da informação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)
  • Configurar e manter Archive InfoStructures (AIS), incluindo catálogo de campos, build/load/unload

  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores (KPIs) para stakeholders
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e propor melhorias e automações
  • Atuar em conjunto com times globais na restauração de serviços e troubleshooting

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com SAP Archiving (ADK e AIS)
  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de Windows Server
  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance
  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP ILM (Retention Management e Retention Warehouse)
  • Noções de ABAP para suporte e ajustes em rotinas de arquivamento
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Essa pessoa atuará na otimização contínua da experiência, reduzindo atritos, recuperando leads e aumentando a eficiência do funil por meio de automação, testes e uso de IA.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar a jornada conversacional de ponta a ponta no WhatsApp, identificando gargalos, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Evoluir a arquitetura dos fluxos conversacionais com foco em experiência, engajamento, recuperação e conversão.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups, segmentações e estrutura de fluxo.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios, campanhas de reengajamento e estratégias de recuperação.
  • Trabalhar na personalização da jornada a partir de clusters de audiência, comportamento e contexto do cliente.
  • Apoiar a construção de dashboards e análises da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados, garantindo visibilidade dos principais indicadores de performance.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com Marketing, Vendas, BI, Operações e Produto/Tech para transformar insights em melhorias concretas na experiência e nos resultados.
  • Contribuir com o uso de IA e automação para escalar conversas com mais eficiência, relevância e capacidade de conversão.

KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Growth, CRO, Lifecycle, CRM, Produto ou áreas correlatas, com foco em conversão e evolução de jornada.
  • Vivência prática com canais conversacionais, especialmente WhatsApp, automação de mensagens e/ou chatbots.
  • Capacidade de mapear funis, identificar gargalos e transformar análise em ação.
  • Repertório em testes A/B, experimentação e otimização contínua de jornada.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada para acompanhar métricas de funil, cohort, LTV, CAC e performance por etapa.
  • Boa visão de experiência do cliente e comportamento em jornadas digitais.
  • Capacidade técnica para utilizar ou estruturar soluções com IA, agentes e automações aplicadas à conversão.
  • Boa comunicação e influência para atuar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, crédito, cobrança, serviços financeiros ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Vivência com desenho de experiências conversacionais e arquitetura de fluxos.
  • Experiência em produto, CX ou gestão de jornadas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Supabase, Metabase, Power BI ou ferramentas similares.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização, qualificação e conversão em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.
  • Experiência com plataformas conversacionais como Blip, ColmeIA ou similares.

Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Engenheiro De Dados Gcp Sr
description:

Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT, com otimização de macros e templates.

Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados.

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Experiência sólida com DBT, modelagem de dados e práticas de orquestração de pipelines.

Conhecimento avançado em BigQuerye Looker e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Proficiência em SQL para otimização e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.

Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação de dados.

Conhecimento avançado em ETL (Informatica PowerCenter, Talend, DataStage, Hadoop e entre outras).

Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas.

Diferencial: Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados.

Parceria com TotalPass para acesso a academias e atividades físicas.

Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.

Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

Contratação PJ.

Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro.

A ATRA é referência em tecnologia e inovação, atuando há mais de 15 anos no mercado de engenharia de dados, data analytics, governança e privacidade. Somos parceiros de grandes empresas como Microsoft, Google, Informatica, Denodo, Atlan e BigID, desenvolvendo soluções que transformam dados em ativos estratégicos. title: Ai Engagement Manager
description:
About Dry Ground AI

Dry Ground AI designs, builds, and maintains AI-powered solutions that accelerate operational velocity for small and mid-sized businesses. Our flagship AI Velocity Plan gives clients a rapid, iterative path from concept to production. You will be the linchpin who keeps those iterations moving forward.

Why This Role Matters

As Engagement Manager, you will own the post-sale customer journey: orchestrating handoffs from Sales to Engineering, driving on-time delivery, and continually identifying new ways to create value. You are part project conductor, part trusted advisor, and part growth catalyst.

Core Responsibilities

Project Leadership

  • Lead multiple AI implementation projects from kickoff through launch and optimization.
  • Create and maintain project plans, timelines, and risk logs
  • Hold engineering and data teams accountable for sprint deliverables, escalate blockers, and manage tradeoffs between scope and schedule.

Customer Success and Relationship Management

  • Act as the main point of contact for a portfolio of AI Velocity and maintenance clients
  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Communicate updates clearly and translate technical milestones into business impact.

Opportunity Expansion

  • Analyze client workflows and data to uncover new AI opportunities.
  • Frame and scope these opportunities as projects to add to the Velocity backlog.
  • Collaborate with Sales to support renewals and upsells.

Process Improvement

  • Improve our delivery playbook, templates, and dashboards.
  • Promote best practices in documentation, change management, and knowledge transfer.

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English speaking and writing skills. You will run executive meetings and prepare client-facing materials.
  • 5 or more years managing complex software or data/AI projects.
  • Strong experience in customer-facing roles such as Customer Success, Consulting, or Solutions Delivery.
  • Comfortable engaging with technical teams about APIs, data pipelines, and ML concepts. You do not need to code, but must bridge the gap between business and technical language.
  • Proficient with tools like Notion, Jira, and Asana.
  • Analytical thinker who can read KPIs, prioritize work, and quantify ROI.
  • Employment verification, education verification, and an international background check will be required.
  • Must be authorized to work in your local jurisdiction.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with GenAI, LLM tools, or MLOps platforms such as LangChain, Pinecone, or vector databases.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS commercial models.
  • Certifications like PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM are a plus.

What We Offer

  • High-impact role on a fast-moving team building innovative AI solutions.
  • Work from anywhere. We are a fully remote company with clients based in the U.S.
  • Competitive time off and flexible work environment.
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities.
  • Training and development support.
  • Work-from-home allowance.

Nice to have

  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Experience working in agency or fast-paced product environments
  • Strong taste in UI implementation and attention to detail

What success looks like

  • You can take a Figma file and turn it into a live, polished website quickly using AI

About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)

  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

title: Operador De Área – Energia / Tg
description:
A Arauco é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais e se compromete com a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas práticas de contratação.

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Liderar e executar as atividades operacionais complexas de campo na área de Energia e Turbogeradores, atuando como referência técnica e mentor para a equipe, assim como garantir a operação otimizada, segura e contínua dos sistemas de geração e distribuição de energia elétrica e vapor, antecipando e solucionando anomalias complexas, participando ativamente de análises de desvios e propondo melhorias que visam aumentar a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e eficiência energética da fábrica.

Principais Atividades:

  • Operar e otimizar equipamentos e sistemas de campo da área de Energia e Turbogeradores, incluindo combustão, vapor, resfriamento, lubrificação e sistemas de água;
  • Apoiar e operarsistemas automatizados (SDCS), substituindo operador de painel quando necessário;
  • Liderar a equipe de campo na identificação e solução de problemas operacionais complexos, falhas de equipamentos e desvios de processo;
  • Realizar inspeções técnicas detalhadas, identificando desgaste, falhas iminentes e desvios de performance;
  • Executar manobras operacionais críticas, isolamentos de equipamentos e atuar em situações de emergência seguindo planos de contingência;
  • Preparar equipamentos para manutenção, aplicando rigorosamente bloqueios e etiquetagens;
  • Coletar, registrar e analisar dados de campo, identificando tendências e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Atuar como mentor, treinando operadores I e II e promovendo o desenvolvimento da equipe;
  • Participar de análises de causa raiz (RCA) e implementar melhorias em procedimentos, equipamentos e práticas de segurança;
  • Colaborar com manutenção e engenharia no comissionamento de equipamentos, testes e otimização de processos;
  • Garantir cumprimento de normas de segurança, ambientais e operacionais (NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35), promovendo cultura de segurança;
  • Monitorar consumo de utilitários (água, vapor, ar) e propor otimizações;
  • Cumprir e disseminar políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde Ocupacional e Compliance.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Curso Técnico em Papel e Celulose, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação Industrial e/ou afins;
  • Conhecimento emIntegração em Segurança e uso de ferramentas da qualidade;
  • Pacote Office básico;
  • Conhecimento dos princípios de funcionamento de turbinas a vapor e geradores elétricos, incluindo sistemas auxiliares (lubrificação, selagem, vácuo, condensação e resfriamento);
  • Conhecimento desistemas de alta pressão e temperatura;
  • Familiaridade com distribuição elétrica de alta e média tensão (disjuntores, transformadores, painéis de controle);
  • Conhecimento das normas de segurança do trabalho aplicáveis (NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35);
  • Capacidade de interpretar diagramas de processo, instrumentação, elétricos e fluxogramas de engenharia;
  • Conhecimento prático em manutenção básica e diagnóstico de falhas em equipamentos rotativos (alinhamento, balanceamento, lubrificação avançada);
  • Noções de instrumentação de campo e calibração básica;
  • CNH categoria B;
  • Disponibilidade para residir e trabalhar em Inocência/MS.

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support, Cyber Threat Takedown Operations, and Security Event Analysis. You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.

2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.

3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and "Control Tower" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master's degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Sap S/4 Hana Brim Application Expert
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.

PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.

KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.

SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline

Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, acompanhar e evoluir indicadores (KPIs) de frotas.
  • Estruturar, tratar e analisar bases de dados, realizando processos de ETL, limpeza e modelagem.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir dashboards gerenciais e operacionais em Power BI.

  • Domínio intermediário de Power BI (modelagem de dados, DAX, criação de dashboards e otimização de performance).

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. title: Media Buyer
description:
Senior Media Buyer – Home Renovation / Roofing (Video-First)

Location

Remote

Full-time

About Us

We're a lean, A1 performance marketing team serving 30+ roofing contractors across the U.S., and we're scaling aggressively to 100+ clients.

No bloated layers. No politics. No babysitting.

We specialize in video-driven paid media systems that generate booked appointments and signed jobs for roofing and home renovation businesses. If you don't understand contractors, sales cycles, and how to turn ads into revenue — this is not the role for you.

If you do — you'll have autonomy, trust, and real impact.

The Role (Read Carefully)

We're hiring a Senior Media Buyer who can own campaign execution end-to-end for roofing and home renovation clients.

This is not a "strategy-only" role.

This is not a "just launch ads and wait" role.

You will:

  • Set up
  • Launch
  • Optimize
  • Scale

Video-first paid media systems across TOF / MOF / BOF.

You must understand how contractors think, how homeowners buy, and how to turn attention into booked jobs.

Core Responsibilities

1. Campaign Setup & Launch

  • Build and launch Meta (Facebook/Instagram) video campaigns for roofing & home renovation clients
  • Structure accounts cleanly (TOF / MOF / BOF separation)
  • Implement proper tracking, events, and reporting
  • QA everything before launch — no sloppy work

2. Funnel Ownership (TOF → MOF → BOF)

You must know how to:

  • Run TOF video ads for awareness and demand creation
  • Build MOF retargeting (video views, engagement, site traffic)
  • Execute BOF conversion campaigns (lead forms, landing pages, booked calls)
  • Diagnose where funnels break and fix them fast

3. Video Ad Performance Optimization

  • Analyze hooks, angles, creatives, and messaging
  • Kill losers fast, scale winners responsibly
  • Give clear feedback on what video content is needed to improve results
  • Understand what works specifically in roofing & home renovation

4. Client Readiness & Professional Conduct

  • You don't talk like a marketer — you talk like a business operator
  • Campaign updates are clear, calm, and confident
  • You understand contractor economics (job size, close rates, seasonality)
  • You protect the agency's reputation at all times

Required Experience (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

  • 3+ years managing paid social campaigns
  • Direct experience in home renovation or roofing marketing
  • Proven results using video ads (Meta primarily)
  • Experience running full-funnel paid media systems
  • Strong understanding of lead quality, not just CPL
  • Ability to work independently without hand-holding

If you've never marketed roofing, remodeling, windows, HVAC, solar, or similar trades — don't apply.

Who You Are

  • Tactical, fast, and detail-oriented
  • Calm under pressure
  • Takes ownership and responsibility
  • Doesn't make excuses — fixes problems
  • Understands that performance >
    opinions
  • Wants to grow with a team scaling hard

This Role Is NOT For You If:

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About AdManage.Ai Type: Full-Time We're building the Cursor for ad management.

AdManage.Ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & TikTok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50M+ in ad spend, our mission is to level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.

Our platform launches 900,000+ ads per month, saving advertisers hours with bulk ad creation, creative mining, and AI-powered campaign tools. We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience — not just ideas.

The Mission Our users are ambitious brands and agencies who rely on us not just for software, but for expertise that helps them scale profitably. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Junior Customer Success Manager with a media buying background who can bridge the gap between software and performance marketing. You'll ensure our customers get real outcomes with AdManage.Ai — not just features. You'll be supported by a strong CS team and learn fast.

What You'll Do

  • Support onboarding: help guide new customers from setup to first wins alongside senior team members.
  • Be a go-to resource: use your media buying knowledge to answer questions on campaign structure, creative testing, and platform features.
  • Drive adoption: help customers unlock the full value of features like bulk ad launching, creative mining, and performance dashboards.
  • Build relationships: be a reliable, friendly point of contact for brands, agencies, and growth teams.
  • Close the feedback loop: surface customer pain points to our product and engineering teams. We ship continuously — your insights will hit production fast.
  • Help reduce churn: flag at-risk accounts early and work with the team to find solutions.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 6 months of experience in a customer-facing role (CSM, account management, support, or similar in a SaaS company).
  • Strong communication skills — you're confident on Google Meet, email, and Slack.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, including Claude Code for automating repetitive tasks, drafting customer communications, or building lightweight internal tools.
  • Startup mentality: eager to learn, comfortable with ambiguity, and happy to wear multiple hats.
  • Curiosity, empathy, and a bias for action are non-negotiable.

Bonus Points For

  • Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or TikTok Ads at a campaign level
  • Any exposure to SaaS tools or ad tech platforms
  • Experience using Claude Code or similar agentic AI tools to automate workflows
  • Prior internship or junior role at a startup or agency
  • Some hands-on experience with paid social (Meta, TikTok) — whether through internships, agency work, freelance, or running your own campaigns.

Why Join Us

  • Join an amazing Customer Success team and grow fast.
  • Direct impact: your feedback shapes our product roadmap from day one.
  • Work alongside founders who've scaled brands like ZOE, Photoroom, and Nextdoor.

How to Apply Send your LinkedIn and 2–3 lines on: What's a performance marketing challenge you've helped solve — or one you're fascinated by? Bonus: any results or campaigns you're proud of, however small.

title: Data Architect – Snowflake || Brazil/Remote
description:
Data Architect – Snowflake

Advance hands-on SQL

Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

- End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

- Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

- Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

- Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

- Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

- Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

- Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

- Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

- 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

- Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

- Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

- Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

- Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

- Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

- Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

- Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

- Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

- Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

- Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

- Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

- Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

- Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

- Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

- Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

- Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India's most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world's fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we've grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK's Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer's digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers' attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK's Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK's products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.

Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK's platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK's solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK's products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.

What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.

Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery

Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You'll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!

CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Técnico Mecânica Iii (Secagem)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Liderar e executar atividades complexas de manutenção mecânica preventiva e corretiva nos equipamentos e sistemas da linha de secagem de celulose, atuando no diagnóstico de falhas críticas e na implementação de soluções técnicas que garantam a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança dos ativos. Conduzir intervenções em equipamentos do processo, como depuradores, rolos de processo, cortadeiras e sistemas de enfardamento, incluindo amarradeira, encapadeira, dobradeira e prensa PR15, assegurando o correto funcionamento dos sistemas mecânicos. Atuar conforme planos de manutenção, procedimentos técnicos e normas de segurança, contribuindo para a estabilidade operacional, aumento da disponibilidade dos equipamentos e melhoria contínua da eficiência do processo.

Atividades Principais:

  • Planejar, executar e supervisionar atividades de manutenção preventiva de alta complexidade em equipamentos e máquinas das áreas de secagem e enfardamento (secadores, sistemas de transporte de celulose seca), otimizando planos e procedimentos, identificando e corrigindo falhas potenciais e garantindo a confiabilidade dos ativos;
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas críticas em equipamentos e máquinas, utilizando instrumentos de diagnóstico avançados (análise de vibração, termografia, ultrassom), desenvolvendo planos de reparo eficientes e liderando a equipe na execução de intervenções complexas, incluindo desmontagem, montagem, alinhamento de precisão, balanceamento dinâmico e serviços especializados de solda e usinagem;
  • Liderar a análise de falhas recorrentes e críticas, utilizando metodologias de análise de causa raiz (RCA), desenvolvendo soluções técnicas inovadoras e propondo modificações e melhorias nos equipamentos e sistemas para aumentar a confiabilidade, reduzir custos de manutenção e otimizar a performance;
  • Ler e interpretar desenhos técnicos mecânicos detalhados, diagramas hidráulicos e pneumáticos complexos, manuais de equipamentos especializados e especificações técnicas avançadas, assim como, elaborar planos de manutenção detalhados, procedimentos de trabalho seguros (PTs) e instruções de trabalho (ITs);
  • Utilizar e garantir a correta calibração de ferramentas manuais, elétricas, pneumáticas e instrumentos de medição de alta precisão e diagnóstico avançado, seguindo as normas de segurança e conservação;
  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de melhoria de equipamentos e instalações, definindo escopo, recursos, cronograma e liderando a equipe na montagem, comissionamento e testes de novos equipamentos nas áreas designadas;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos detalhados sobre as atividades de manutenção executadas, as falhas críticas diagnosticadas, as soluções aplicadas, as análises de causa raiz e as recomendações para futuras intervenções e melhorias, apresentando resultados e análises para a gestão;
  • Treinar, mentorar e avaliar o desempenho técnico dos técnicos mecânicos I e II, compartilhando conhecimentos especializados, melhores práticas de manutenção e desenvolvendo as habilidades da equipe;
  • Garantir o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de segurança do trabalho, utilizando e fiscalizando o uso dos Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) adequados para cada atividade, liderando a elaboração de procedimentos de segurança, análise de risco (APR) e identificando e mitigando situações de risco;
  • Liderar e participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas com a equipe de manutenção, engenharia e outras áreas, contribuindo com expertise técnica para a solução de problemas complexos, a definição de estratégias de manutenção e a melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;

Requisitos

  • Curso técnico completo em Mecânica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em mecânica industrial (elementos de máquinas, lubrificação industrial especializada, sistemas hidráulicos e pneumáticos complexos, transmissão de potência, termodinâmica básica);
  • Leitura e interpretação avançada de desenhos técnicos mecânicos detalhados, diagramas complexos e manuais de equipamentos especializados;
  • Conhecimento emdiagnóstico avançado de falhas mecânicas, utilizando instrumentos de medição de alta precisão e técnicas de análise (análise de vibração avançada, termografia, ultrassom, análise de óleo);
  • Conhecimento avançado em alinhamento de equipamentos (laser e mecânico), balanceamento dinâmico, análise de vibração e outras técnicas de manutenção preditiva;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em normas de segurança do trabalho (NR-13, NR-33, NR-35) e legislação pertinente;
  • Conhecimento emsistemas de gestão da manutenção (CMMS) e análise de dados de manutenção.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. title: Técnico Em Segurança Do Trabalho - Florestal
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais Atividades:

  • Inspecionar, acompanhar e garantir o cumprimento das normas de Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho (SST), legislações aplicáveis e diretrizes corporativas da empresa;
  • Identificar perigos e avaliar riscos ocupacionais relacionados a acidentes de trabalho e doenças ocupacionais, propondo e acompanhando a implementação de medidas de eliminação, mitigação ou controle;
  • Orientar, capacitar e conscientizar os colaboradores e terceiros quanto aos procedimentos de segurança, Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs), padrões corporativos e boas práticas de SST;
  • Realizar análises de risco, liberações de atividades de alto risco, conforme requisitos legais e procedimentos internos;
  • Atuar nas investigações de incidentes e acidentes, participando da análise de causas, definição e acompanhamento das ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Monitorar, consolidar e analisar indicadores de desempenho em SST (ex.: taxa de acidentes, desvios, inspeções, observações comportamentais, planos de ação), apoiando a gestão e a tomada de decisão;
  • Realizar rotinas de campo, inspeções de segurança e acompanhamento das atividades operacionais, com interface direta junto às lideranças operacionais;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fiscalizações e avaliações corporativas relacionadas à SST, assegurando aderência aos requisitos legais e padrões da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Formação completa em Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho, com registro ativo;
  • Experiência comprovada no setor florestal;
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática na aplicação das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e requisitos legais de SST;
  • Vivência em gestão de riscos, indicadores de SST e rotinas operacionais de campo;
  • CNH categoria B– definitiva;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuar e/ou residir em Paranaíba / MS.

title: It Risk Management Lead
description:
IT Risk Management Lead

Comcentia is seeking an experienced IT Risk Management Lead to drive the design, build‐out, and continuous improvement of our client's enterprise IT Risk Management Program. This role leads the development of risk intake processes, assessment methodologies, and quantitative models aligned with NIST‐based frameworks and the organization's ISMS.

You'll partner with Cybersecurity, IT, business stakeholders, and risk owners to identify, assess, document, and monitor technology risks across the enterprise. The Lead serves as the primary SME for IT risk, producing executive‐ready reporting, maturing risk metrics and dashboards, and ensuring treatment plans are well‐defined, tracked, and executed.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead structured IT risk assessments and apply quantitative scoring models

- Enhance risk intake processes, assessment tools, and framework alignment

- Maintain the enterprise risk register and map risks to SCF‐aligned controls

- Drive treatment planning, cross‐functional coordination, and lifecycle tracking

- Deliver risk reporting, dashboards, and decision‐ready materials for leadership

- Support governance cycles, audit readiness, and GRC tooling adoption

- Champion automation and AI‐enabled workflows to improve program efficiency

Qualifications:

- 7+ years in IT Risk Management, ISMS, or Cybersecurity

- Strong English proficiency (TOEFL Score: 90+) required

- Experience leading enterprise risk programs—not just contributing to them

- Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI, GDPR

- Hands‐on experience with GRC platforms and risk assessment methodologies

- Excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences

- Preferred certifications: ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISSP, CISM, SCF Practitioner
